overall: The AG declined to review whether the Conservation Director had authority to draft the memo, and found no improper deliberation because only two commissioners were involved, below a quorum of four. No violation found.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Conservation Director lacked authority to draft and submit a December memorandum to the Board on the Commission's behalf.
allegations.key_passage: As such, any allegation that the Conservation Director did not have authority to draft the memorandum would not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law even if true, and we therefore decline to review such allegation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission engaged in improper deliberation in creating a December memorandum supporting one of two candidates for an open seat.
allegations.key_passage: Where two Commissioners do not constitute a quorum of the Commission, we find that there was no improper deliberation in connection to the creation of the memorandum.
